solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Astonishment over American priest discovered in tower

indicators.note: over signals that the abbreviation for American is turned around, read back to front
discovered in means found inside, so the priest's abbreviation sits within the verb for tower

parts.note: to tower is to rise high above

explanation.surface: Someone is amazed to find a US clergyman lurking in a church tower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tower' reads as a noun, a building, but it is the verb, to rise up. 'over' turns US to SU.
explanation.definitionFit: Astonishment is the feeling of being taken aback by something unexpected, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Fairy finding prince in position

indicators.note: in places the prince abbreviation inside the position word

parts.note: a site is a position or location

explanation.surface: A fairy-tale heroine finds a prince in just the right place.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprite is an elf or fairy of folklore.

clue.text: Soldiers, by not speaking about it at first, able to withstand disappointment

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

indicators.note: about means going around, so the not-speaking word surrounds the single letter

parts.note: silent means not speaking

indicators.note: at first points to the opening letter of it

explanation.surface: Troops who keep quiet are tough enough to cope with being let down.
explanation.definitionFit: Resilient people recover quickly from setbacks, so they can withstand disappointment.

clue.text: Revive Redwood's principal supporter

indicators.note: principal means first in rank, pointing to the opening letter of Redwood

parts.note: an ally is a supporter

explanation.surface: A politician named Redwood's leading backer brings him back to life.
explanation.walkthrough: John Redwood is a British Conservative politician, which colours the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To rally is to recover strength or spirits, so to revive.

clue.text: Straw spread around the finish by key racecourse official

indicators.note: by places the key letter beside the rest
around means the shuffled letters encircle the single letter
spread signals the letters of straw are scattered and rearranged
the finish points to the last letter of the

parts.note: D is a musical key

explanation.surface: A course official scatters straw around the finishing line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spread' rearranges STRAW to STWAR, and E (end of 'the') goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: A steward supervises procedure and rules at a horse race meeting.

clue.text: Chapter on compassion cut by Conservative supporter

indicators.note: cut by means split open by another piece, so the Conservative letter is put inside the compassion word

parts.note: ruth is an old word for pity or compassion, surviving in ruthless

explanation.surface: A political book chapter about compassion is trimmed by a Tory backer.
explanation.walkthrough: RUTH (compassion) is rare outside 'ruthless'. 'on' is a link joining the chapter to what follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A crutch is a prop that supports someone's weight, literally or figuratively.

clue.text: Refuse to accept general opinion over help from the south

indicators.note: over means the general opinion word lies across and around the help word

parts.note: repute is what people generally think of someone

indicators.note: from the south means read upwards in a down entry, so the help word is turned backwards

parts.note: aid means help

explanation.surface: Someone declines both popular consensus and assistance arriving from down south.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the south' reverses AID to DIA in a down light.
explanation.definitionFit: To repudiate is to reject or disown something.

clue.text: God facing new source of irritation

parts.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder

explanation.surface: A deity confronts a fresh annoyance.
explanation.definitionFit: A thorn in one's side is a persistent annoyance, hence a source of irritation.

clue.text: Woman against supporting strike until now

indicators.note: supporting, in a down clue, sets the woman and against pieces beneath the strike word

parts.note: to hit is to strike
her stands for a woman
to can mean against, as in face to face or close to

explanation.surface: A woman opposes backing the industrial action that is still going on.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'supporting' puts HER TO below HIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitherto means up to this time, so until now.

clue.text: Determined to dispel doubts at the outset

parts.note: to resolve something can mean to dissolve or dispel it, as doubts are resolved

indicators.note: at the outset points to the opening letter of the word doubts

explanation.surface: A resolute person clears away any uncertainty right from the beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: Being resolved is being firmly set on a course of action, a synonym of determined.

clue.text: Shoot Republican on board jet

indicators.note: on board means carried inside, so the party letter goes within the word for a jet

parts.note: a spout is a jet or stream of liquid

explanation.surface: A gunman targets a US politician travelling on a private jet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shoot' and 'jet' suggest guns and aircraft; here a shoot is new plant growth and a jet is a stream of water.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprout is a young shoot growing from a plant or seed.

clue.text: Check in dog book

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: A vet looks over the dog listed in a pedigree register.
explanation.definitionFit: To curb is to restrain or hold in check.

clue.text: Correspond with Mark

definitions.meaning: to agree or match up with something else, as figures do
a mark scored to keep count

explanation.definitionFit: To tally is to match up; a tally is a counting mark, two senses of one word.

clue.text: Bid for a great amount

definitions.meaning: in the card game solo whist, a bid undertaking to win nine tricks
a plentiful supply, more than enough of something

explanation.walkthrough: The first sense comes from solo whist, a British card game in which this is the bid to take nine tricks.
explanation.definitionFit: Plenty or profusion is the ordinary sense; the card-game bid is a technical one.

clue.text: It provides evidence of core changes after rector died

indicators.note: after places the shuffled core letters following the rector's letter
changes signals that the letters of the word core are rearranged

explanation.surface: Proof of altered core teaching emerges after the vicar's death.
explanation.definitionFit: A record is a written account kept as proof of what happened.

clue.text: Foolish Tibetan so headstrong

indicators.note: foolish signals that the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A silly Tibetan is also stubborn.
explanation.definitionFit: An obstinate person is stubborn and unwilling to give way.

clue.text: Offensively obtrusive and pointless complaint by social worker

indicators.note: pointless means losing a compass point, here the east letter

parts.note: a bleat is a whining complaint
an ant is a worker in a social insect colony

explanation.surface: A rude, in-your-face moan comes from a council care worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pointless' removes E (east, a compass point) from BLEAT, leaving BLAT. 'social worker' suggests welfare, but it is an insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Blatant behaviour is glaringly conspicuous and unashamedly offensive.

clue.text: Learn from sectarian trouble

indicators.note: trouble, as a verb, means disturb, so the letters of sectarian are stirred up

explanation.surface: Lessons are to be drawn from religious unrest.
explanation.definitionFit: To ascertain is to find out or discover a fact, so to learn it.

clue.text: Important ball oddly ignored by top fashion designer

parts.note: Pierre Cardin was a leading French fashion designer

indicators.note: oddly ignored means the odd-placed letters of ball are dropped, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: A big society ball shuns a famous couturier for no obvious reason.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly ignored' keeps letters 2 and 4 of BALL, giving AL.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardinal means of chief importance, as in cardinal sins or points.

clue.text: Edges of racket clamped by exceptional Asian craftsman

indicators.note: clamped by means gripped on both sides, so the edge letters are held within the shuffled letters
exceptional signals that the letters of Asian are rearranged
edges of points to the first and last letters of racket

explanation.surface: A remarkable Asian craftsman grips the frame of a tennis racket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exceptional' turns ASIAN into AISAN; 'Edges of' gives RT from racket, gripped inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An artisan is a skilled worker who makes things by hand.

clue.text: Born and died in want

parts.note: nee, from French, means born, used before a maiden name

explanation.surface: Someone was born and died in poverty.
explanation.definitionFit: Need is a state of lacking things, the same as want in its sense of poverty.

clue.text: Drawing of group outside Knutsford's earliest church

indicators.note: outside means the group word wraps around the single letter

parts.note: a set is a group of things or people

indicators.note: earliest points to the opening letter of Knutsford

explanation.surface: A picture shows a party gathered outside a church in Knutsford, a Cheshire town.
explanation.walkthrough: Knutsford is a small town in Cheshire, England; only its first letter K is used.
explanation.definitionFit: A sketch is a rough, quick drawing.

clue.text: It is removed from new athletics bag

indicators.note: these words say the given letters are taken out of a fresh arrangement of athletics

explanation.surface: A sports bag is taken away from a new athletics kit.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove I and T from ATHLETICS and rearrange the remaining seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A satchel is a shoulder bag, traditionally for school books.

clue.text: Stop heavenly body getting old

parts.note: a comet is a heavenly body

explanation.surface: An old star or meteor ceases to move across the sky.
explanation.walkthrough: To come to is a sailing term: to bring a vessel to a halt, heading into the wind.
explanation.definitionFit: In nautical use a vessel brought to a halt is said to come to, so this means stop.

clue.text: Duke isn't accepting insolence from a government opponent

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the insolence word goes inside

parts.note: taken as written without the apostrophe
side is an old word for swagger or putting on airs

explanation.surface: An aristocrat refuses to put up with cheek from a political rebel.
explanation.walkthrough: SIDE in the sense of pretentiousness or arrogance (putting on side) is British slang.
explanation.definitionFit: A dissident is someone who openly opposes an established regime.

clue.text: Helping to make one rising up deceptively alluring

indicators.note: up means read upwards in this down entry, so the run is turned backwards
helping to make means forming part of, so the letters lie within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A person getting up is lured by something enticing but false.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'one rising' backwards (gnisir eno) and the run sits inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective, as in a siren call, it describes something tempting but dangerous.

clue.text: Success after actor's debut in French film

indicators.note: after puts the success word following the rest
in places the actor's first letter inside the abbreviation for French
debut points to the first letter of actor

parts.note: a go is a success, as in making a go of it

explanation.surface: An actor makes a hit in his first French movie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French film' looks like the definition, but French gives FR and 'film' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Fargo is a 1996 film by the Coen brothers.

clue.text: Meeting unionist during ceremony

indicators.note: during means within the span of, so the unionist letter goes inside

parts.note: a form is a set ceremony or ritual
U stands for Unionist, as in Northern Irish politics

explanation.surface: A trade unionist turns up during a formal ceremony.
explanation.definitionFit: A forum is a meeting for open discussion.

clue.text: Country show finally taken in by girl at the end of May

indicators.note: taken in by means held inside, so the final letter of show goes into the girl's name

parts.note: Nora is a girl's name

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of show
at the end of points to the final letter of May

explanation.surface: A girl puts on a performance in late May somewhere in the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Norway is a Scandinavian nation, one example of a country.

clue.text: Lack of time after Rex appears in photo

indicators.note: after places the time word following the photo piece
appears in means sits within, so the king's letter goes inside the photo word

parts.note: a shot is a photograph
R stands for Rex, Latin for king
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A dog named Rex shows up in a snapshot, though time is short.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortage is a lack or deficiency of something needed.

clue.text: Remain behind border to protect German queen

indicators.note: to protect means to surround and shield, so the German letter sits inside the border word

parts.note: a line is a border or boundary
R is for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: Guards stay back at the frontier to shield a German queen.
explanation.definitionFit: To linger is to stay on after others have left.

clue.text: Female meeting city fellows at company dance

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles, the standard crossword city
men are fellows

explanation.surface: A woman meets some men from the city at a firm's party.
explanation.definitionFit: Flamenco is a passionate Spanish style of dance.
